components.cost_effect: One LO query per gap test; no new gradient of f inside this subproblem.
components.goal: Obtain a controlled inexact quadratic subproblem solution while reusing the outer gradient.
components.key_estimate: At termination <g+β(u^+-u),u^+-x>≤η for every x∈X, by the definition of the maximum in (2.4).
components.name: CndG Wolfe-gap termination
components.operation: Minimize the linearization of φ(x)=<g,x>+β||x-u||²/2 over X, test its Wolfe gap, and otherwise take the clipped exact quadratic segment minimizer (2.5).
components.requires: Inner-product quadratic geometry, β>0, exact LO and nonnegative tolerance.
transfer_checks: Changing geometry requires a new quadratic/segment calculation.
Inexact LO changes both the gap certificate and the outer analysis.
Changing tolerance requires new outer error accumulation and inner cost analysis.

limitations.statement: The companion Corollary 3 record remains lead because the source inner-gap proof and exact resource accounting require resolution. No certified performance link is supplied here.
This extraction does not cover strongly convex, stochastic, Bregman or saddle-point variants, and does not establish unrestricted Oracle Complexity.

variants.cost: Exactly N outer gradient queries. Each execution of CndG step 2 costs one exact LO call, including the final call used to certify termination. If a CndG call performs r updates, it makes r+1 LO calls. Inner quadratic gradients use the stored g and vector arithmetic, without additional f-gradient queries. Vector arithmetic, inner products, storage and feasibility initialization are separate unquantified computational resources; no projection call is prescribed.
variants.name: Smooth-convex CGS with Corollary 3 parameters
variants.output: Return y_N∈X as prescribed by Algorithm 1; the output is formed by convex combinations of initial and LO-generated points. No unrestricted-output lower bound is claimed.
public_inputs: Positive smoothness constant L and exact positive diameter D_X
variants.query_and_update: For k=1,...,N set z_k=(1-γ_k)y_{k-1}+γ_k x_{k-1}; query g=f'(z_k). Call CndG(g,x_{k-1},β_k,η_k): at inner point u^t compute q_t=g+β(u^t-u), choose v^t∈argmin_{x∈X}<q_t,x>, and evaluate V_t=<q_t,u^t-v^t>. If V_t≤η return u^t as x_k. Otherwise set α_t=max{0,min{1,<β(u-u^t)-g,v^t-u^t>/(β||v^t-u^t||²)}} and u^{t+1}=(1-α_t)u^t+α_t v^t; increment t and repeat. Set y_k=(1-γ_k)y_{k-1}+γ_k x_k. The gap test precedes the division in (2.5).
variants.requirements: X is a nonempty compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional inner-product space, with D_X=max_{x,y∈X}||x-y||>0. f is convex differentiable with L-Lipschitz gradient in the corresponding primal/dual norms, L>0. Exact gradients and exact linear minimization over X are available.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set y_0=x_0∈X. Maintain x_k,y_k,z_k. For each CndG call with fixed g,u,β,η initialize u^1=u and t=1.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: β_k=3L/(k+1), γ_k=3/(k+2), η_k=LD_X²/[k(k+1)] for every k≥1. Stop each inner call at its exact Wolfe-gap test; stop the outer loop at supplied N. The source error target is specified in Corollary 3; this Algorithm record does not certify a complexity bound.
